mentions.name: RainbowSay
mentions.description: RainbowSay is a language-learning app that auto-pauses video when it detects a sentence and provides translation, per-word vocabulary breakdowns, and grammar explanations, replacing manual copy-pasting of subtitles into an AI chat. It also supports microphone voice input for deliberate speaking practice of learned material, with spaced repetition.
mentions.problem: Manually pausing video and copy-pasting subtitles into an AI chat for vocabulary, translation, and grammar breakdowns is tedious and interrupts learning.
mentions.audience: People learning languages through streaming media, such as K-drama viewers studying Korean
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I automated it in an app which auto pauses video when it detects a sentence and gives translation, vocabulary (for every word) and grammar.

I also added same to voice from microphone, for deliberate practice speaking what was learned. To help with spaced repetition.
